title: TaskForce evidence file, version 1
description: The chained journal of one mission: who asked, which agent acted, on which sources, under which rules, who decided, what left the sandbox. Each event is chained to the previous one (see contracts/README.md); the header comes from the chain; an exported file is checked without TaskForce by recomputing the hashes, the header, the texts kept beside the chain, the decisions judged again with the rules bundle, and the seal.

issue.description: The issue key, for example WEB-48.

requestedBy.description: The person who delegated, by the opaque id the chain names people with (person: and 32 hex digits; their email and name are texts kept beside the chain, in a note of kind person). Null in a file opened before 1.18, whose chain does not say.

runnerFacts.description: Present when a runner took the mission: what it reports (its tests, the agent and its model, the numbers of its events) comes from the computer where the agent works, whatever the custody of the key.

rules.description: The rules bundle as the mission received it (taskforce-rules/1): its digest is the one mission.started holds, so a third party judges each decision again.

texts.description: The texts kept beside the chain, by their hash: the chain holds only their sha256 and length. The hash is the SHA-256 of the text's salt followed by the text, so a hash left alone does not confirm a guess. An erased text is absent, with its salt.

salt.description: 128 random bits, drawn for this text.

envelope.description: The last seal: a DSSE envelope of an in-toto Statement v1, signed in Ed25519 (contracts/README.md, Seal).

payload.description: The canonical JSON of the statement, in base64.

sig.description: The Ed25519 signature of the DSSE pre-authentication encoding, in base64.

data.description: Integers, strings, booleans, null, arrays and objects only: no decimal numbers.
